description: Make a pending change real, or drop it: body {apply: true or false}. Applying runs it in one piece -- either all of it happens or none of it does -- and writes down what undoing it would take, so it can be put back afterwards. Ask the user in plain words first and repeat the one-line summary back to them; this is the call that touches live advertising and spend. -- MakeHybrid API plan, POST /google-ads/v1/changes/{change_id}/apply, group google-ads.

change_id.description: Value for the {change_id} segment of /google-ads/v1/changes/{change_id}/apply. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
